PRECIPITATION PROBABILITIES

Event probability: P(observed precipitation event | forecast event). Hour probability: P(observed wet hour | forecast wet hour). Forecast wet signal: >0.1 mm/h (unchanged for all thresholds below). Maturation delay: an hour/event is only counted once real time has passed 12h past its own valid time/event end (late ARSO corrections do not retroactively change the ledger; --rebuild remains the safety net for rare late corrections). Lead range: 1–48 h. This is empirical history, not a ranking.

Categories: NEGLIGIBLE >0.1–0.3 mm/h; LIGHT >0.3–1.0 mm/h; MODERATE >1.0–<4.0 mm/h; HEAVY 4.0–10.0 mm/h; DOWNPOUR >10.0 mm/h.

WET >0.1 mm/h; LIGHT+ >0.3 mm/h; MODERATE+ >1.0 mm/h; HEAVY+ ≥4.0 mm/h; DOWNPOUR >10.0 mm/h. Probabilities are cumulative (WET ≥ LIGHT+ ≥ MODERATE+ ≥ HEAVY+ ≥ DOWNPOUR) and share one N per row.
